description: Free. Save the agent voice of your account for one destination country (the same setting as the voice picker in app.deyaho.com/dashboard/mcp). Every later call to that country uses it until you change it. Use list_voices to hear the samples and get ids or names; voice="default" goes back to the country default.

country.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (every destination with voices in list_voices: e.g. MX, ES, US, AR, FR, DE, BE)

voice.description: Voice id or name from list_voices for that country, or "default"

name: set_voice
title: Set your voice
